answer: At the bridge each identity files one plot, prices it 300 credits, locks a 70-credit bond, pays 15% Harberger tax per epoch. Plots sit on a shared tundra, one per identity; anyone may buy at the posted price, so underpricing loses plots. A velvet seal marks filings once tax clears; forged ones burn bonds. 1,000 fakes pay 45,000 tax per epoch, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files one plot, pays 45 per epoch, keeps its share.
